Proceed to Payment: Release funds via foreign bank transfer.

Request Mode of Payment: Confirm terms (COD, Net 30, Bank Transfer).

Fill out IPAS Form: Submit internal payment authorization request.
Proceed to Payment: Disburse payment (check, bank transfer).
Mode of Shipping: Select domestic delivery method (courier, vendor delivery, pick-up).
Transmittal Form: Route PO and receipt copies to Finance/Receiving.
Coordinate Logistics: Dispatch local driver or track supplier delivery.
Turn Over to Warehouse: Hand off goods for receiving report and inventory logging.

TSR Number:
Receive item from Purchasing
Provide picture
Provide video
TSR Report with serial number
proper attachments
Fill out form : put SALES ORDER  if item is project
Receive item

Check quality of item
Prepare the items based on the Sales Order.
Seal, mark, and properly label the items.
Prepare the packing list each boxes or packing
Receive the packages or boxes based on the Transmittal Form.
Inspect and check the packages. Report any unusual conditions or damaged cargo.
